prompt: Without looking at any images, describe the most iconic image of Laughing Nailong (大笑奶龙 / 奶蛙) from memory: its pose, expression, body shape, colors, rendering style, and background, in enough detail for an artist who has never seen it to draw it. Say where you are unsure.
answer:
I remember Laughing Nailong as a round, bright-yellow little dinosaur tipping its head back mid-laugh. I’m more confident about the face and body shape than about the exact pose or background of the meme called 大笑奶龙 / 奶蛙.

For the silhouette, draw a squat pear with a bulging belly, short legs, and little arms. Give it a broad, blunt head that joins the torso with almost no visible neck. I picture it facing mostly toward the viewer, chin lifted and arms bent a little away from its sides. I’m unsure of the precise turn of the body or the placement of the hands.

The mouth is the feature I’d draw first. Stretch it across much of the lower face and give it height as well as width, with the corners pulled up into the cheeks. I remember a dark reddish mouth interior and a pink tongue low in the opening. Above it, the eyes squeeze into two small curved slits. The broad face and enormous gape give it a froglike look. I’m unsure whether any teeth show.

I picture smooth, softly shaded 3D animation, with warm golden yellow in the shadows and lighter yellow across the rounded cheeks and belly. The background is the part I can’t reliably recall. For a sketch from this description, I’d use a plain light backdrop and treat that as an artistic choice.
